cues.description: Pointer enters a menu button, list row or combo box entry.
cues.wanted: Very short, dry felt/parchment brush. Under 80 ms, no pitch content.

cues.description: Menu button, list row or combo box entry is activated.
cues.wanted: Firm wood-on-leather confirm tap with a small low-mid body.

cues.description: Player leaves a screen or cancels a dialog.
cues.wanted: Descending two-tone cancel blip, softer and darker than ui.click.

cues.description: Player switches between tabs or side panels.
cues.wanted: Short parchment slide, slightly brighter than ui.click.

cues.description: A panel, settings sheet or overlay opens.
cues.wanted: Leather scroll unrolling, ~250 ms, rising.

cues.description: A panel, settings sheet or overlay closes.
cues.wanted: Leather scroll rolling shut, ~250 ms, falling. Pairs with ui.panel_open.

cues.description: A checkbox, switch or mode toggle changes state.
cues.wanted: Small bronze latch click, two variants for on and off would be ideal.

cues.description: The UI refuses an action (disabled control, invalid input).
cues.wanted: Dull, muted double thud. Must not read as a normal click.

cues.description: A HUD notification or toast is pushed onto the queue.
cues.wanted: Soft parchment-and-quill flourish, ~300 ms. Must not compete with the mission voice line it usually follows.

cues.description: A single friendly unit or building is selected.
cues.wanted: Single short kit tap: one shield knock, dry and close. Under 150 ms.

cues.description: A band of units is selected by drag box, double click or select-all.
cues.wanted: Small group of shields and mail settling at once, ~300 ms. Reads as more than one man, same family as ui.select_unit.

cues.description: The selection is cleared by clicking empty ground.
cues.wanted: Very short soft cloth release, quieter and duller than ui.select_unit.

cues.description: A dialog, settings sheet or destructive choice is confirmed.
cues.wanted: Bronze seal pressed home: firmer and brighter than ui.click, clearly a decision rather than a tap.

cues.description: The simulation accepted a player order.
cues.wanted: Kit acknowledgement: one shield knock with a short bronze ring, under 150 ms. Same family as ui.select_unit but affirmative.

cues.description: The simulation refused a player order, with a reason the UI shows.
cues.wanted: Dull refused thud with a scrape, darker and longer than ui.error so a refused order does not read as a disabled button.

cues.description: Move order issued to the current selection.
cues.wanted: Short kit shuffle: leather, mail rustle, a single boot scuff.

cues.description: Attack order issued against a picked target.
cues.wanted: Sharp single horn stab, dry and close, no reverb tail.

cues.description: Patrol route confirmed between two waypoints.
cues.wanted: Two-note horn phrase, calmer than order.attack.

cues.description: Stop order cancels the current activity.
cues.wanted: Single muted drum hit, abrupt cut.

cues.description: Hold-position mode toggled on the selection.
cues.wanted: Shields planting into dirt, one short thud.

cues.description: Guard mode toggled on the selection.
cues.wanted: Spear butt tapped twice on hard ground.

cues.description: Run mode toggled on the selection.
cues.wanted: Quick kit rattle plus a short breath, suggesting a change of pace.

cues.description: Formation placement mode entered or left.
cues.wanted: Light standard pole shift, cloth snap.

cues.description: Formation ghost committed at the chosen position and angle.
cues.wanted: Standard driven into the ground, single decisive thud.

cues.description: Gate command mode changes (open, close, auto).
cues.wanted: Short iron bolt slide.

cues.description: Rally point placed for a production building.
cues.wanted: Small banner flap plus a peg driven into soil.

cues.description: The commander plants his standard and rallies nearby troops to it.
cues.wanted: A war horn and a shouted rallying call, close and dry.

cues.description: Building placement mode is entered and the ghost appears.
cues.wanted: Surveyor's rope and chalk: a light cord snap plus a stake tap, ~400 ms.

cues.description: A construction site is committed at the chosen spot.
cues.wanted: Decisive corner stake driven in, one hammer blow. Pairs with build.placement_rejected as the positive answer.

cues.description: Construction preview refuses the requested site.
A builder begins work on a construction site.
A construction site finishes and becomes a real building.
A unit is added to a production queue.
cues.wanted: Wax tablet stylus scratch, very short.

cues.description: A produced unit leaves the barracks.
cues.wanted: Single low barracks bell. Must sit under the unit voice line that plays with it.

cues.description: A building, wall segment or gate is destroyed.
cues.wanted: Timber and masonry collapse with a rubble tail, ~2.5 s.

cues.description: A wall gate swings open.
cues.wanted: Heavy wooden gate on iron hinges, opening, ~1.5 s.

cues.description: A wall gate swings shut and bars.
cues.wanted: Gate shutting plus bar drop. Pairs with build.gate_open.

cues.description: An action failed for lack of resources or manpower.
Troop limit reached, production refused.
A building owned by the local player is taking damage.
The local player captures a barrack and gains reinforcements.
The enemy captures a barrack the local player held.
A mission objective is satisfied (for example an undead zone is cleared).
The mission is lost, failing its remaining objectives.
cues.wanted: Short falling brass figure, dark. Mirrors alert.objective_complete.

cues.description: A troop belonging to the local player dies.
cues.wanted: Low mournful drum tap or a single dull bell. Rate limited, so it must survive being heard often.

cues.description: An enemy commander opens a message to the player and the portrait panel slides in.
cues.wanted: A herald's horn heard from another camp, dark and close-mouthed, then the dry turn of a wax tablet. Under 1.5 s. It announces a speaker; it must not sound like a victory fanfare.

cues.description: Sword or gladius lands on a shield or body.
Spear or javelin lands.
Arrow lands on a shield, armour or dirt.
Mounted attack connects.
War elephant attack connects.
Catapult or ballista shot connects.
Fallback impact for unit types with no dedicated family.
A blow lands on a wall, gate or building rather than on a man.
Fighting the player cannot hear individually, because it is too far away, carried as one distant mass instead.
A troop dies.
An archer looses an arrow.
cues.wanted: A single dry bow release, isolated. The current clip is a group recording.

cues.description: A commander starts drawing his bow.
cues.wanted: Sinew and leather taking load, rising over about half a second. It has to end open rather than resolve, because the loose is a separate cue.

cues.description: A commander's draw reaches full and the string holds there.
cues.wanted: One dry, dark seat: the nock settling on the rest and the creak stopping dead. Woodier and quieter than combat.lock_on, which it used to borrow.

cues.description: A commander has held full draw long enough that the arm starts to go.
cues.wanted: A labouring creak falling in pitch under air pushed out through the teeth. It is a warning, so it should sit under the mix rather than punch.

cues.description: A commander looses an aimed arrow from his war bow.
cues.wanted: The heavy cousin of combat.arrow_launch: deeper limb thump, harder string snap, and the shaft audible in the air for longer. It has to read as one man shooting, not a rank of archers.

cues.description: A projectile lands close enough to read as an arrow passing.
A mass of arrows crosses overhead.
A catapult or ballista releases.
cues.wanted: Torsion release: rope creak, wooden arm slam against the stop, ~1 s.

cues.description: A siege projectile lands.
cues.wanted: Stone striking earth or timber with a debris tail, ~1.5 s.

cues.description: A selected body of troops is switched into run mode and breaks into a charge.
cues.wanted: A dedicated charge roar layered with running feet, faction-neutral.

cues.description: A healer restores health to an ally.
cues.wanted: A bright, unmistakable restorative shimmer; the healer's work should read across a battle line.

cues.description: The controlled commander raises their shield.
cues.wanted: Shield swung up into guard: leather strap creak plus a short arm-brace thump.

cues.description: An incoming attack is stopped on the commander's raised shield.
cues.wanted: Blade on shield boss, heavy and damped, no ring-out. Distinct from combat.hit.sword, which lands on flesh.

cues.description: An attack is parried inside the perfect-guard window.
cues.wanted: Bright metallic parry ting with a fast tail. Must read as clearly better than combat.block within 100 ms.

cues.description: The commander's guard is broken by posture damage.
cues.wanted: Shield knocked wide: a wooden crack plus a stumbling scrape and a strained breath, ~800 ms.

cues.description: The commander dodge-rolls.
cues.wanted: Body roll on dirt with a fast cloth whoosh and a short exhale, ~500 ms.

cues.description: The commander jumps.
cues.wanted: Short effort grunt plus a kit rattle on the push off. Under 400 ms.

cues.description: The commander lands after a jump.
cues.wanted: Boots and armour landing on packed earth, one thud with a small gravel tail.

cues.description: The commander's shield bash ability connects.
cues.wanted: Shield boss driven into a body: a blunt impact with a low thump, no metal ring.

cues.description: The commander's vanguard rush ability fires.
cues.wanted: Explosive lunge: a hard boot push, a cloth whoosh and a war shout, ~1 s.

cues.description: The commander's second wind ability restores posture and stamina.
cues.wanted: Deep recovering breath with a warm low swell under it, ~1.2 s. Non-magical.

cues.description: A commander ability is pressed while on cooldown or otherwise unavailable.
cues.wanted: Very short dull click, felt rather than heard. Quieter cousin of ui.error so spamming a key never becomes painful.

cues.description: The commander cycles the lock-on target.
cues.wanted: Tight focus tick: a single dry wood-block hit with a hint of pitch rise.

cues.description: The controlled commander plants a foot on open ground.
The same step on a bridge or other hard surface.
The controlled commander plants a foot at a run.
A wolf pack picks up a scent and moves onto prey.
A wolf closes and bites.
The local player wins the mission.
The local player loses the mission.
The player changes the game speed.
cues.wanted: Mechanical notch: a small ratchet or hourglass tick. One clip is enough for every speed step.

cues.description: A save finishes writing.
cues.wanted: Wax seal pressed onto a scroll: a short soft press with a paper settle.

cues.description: A saved battle finishes loading and play resumes.
cues.wanted: Scroll unrolled and set down, ~700 ms. Sits under whatever music starts with the mission.

cues.description: The player takes direct control of their commander.
cues.wanted: Perspective drop: helmet visor closing plus a breath moving close to the mic, ~900 ms.

cues.description: The player leaves direct commander control and returns to the field view.
cues.wanted: Reverse of state.commander_enter: visor lifting, breath pulling back to distance.

cues.description: An Iron Sepulcher zone wakes, or sends another wave of its dead.
cues.wanted: Bones and rusted armour grinding up out of earth and stone. Fires once per wave.

cues.description: A soldier or the commander is staggered out of their current action.
cues.wanted: Armour and body weight losing footing. Distinct from a hit landing.

cues.description: A structure catches fire.
cues.wanted: Timber fire taking hold, no ignition whoosh.

cues.description: A war elephant panics and breaks from its handler.
cues.wanted: Broken, distressed high trumpeting.

cues.description: Resources are delivered to the stockpile.
cues.wanted: Coins and grain into a wooden bowl. Fires often, so it must stay small.
